Task:
Add a request handler `handle_create_user(params)` in `app/api/handlers.py`.
`params["name"]` must be a string with 1 to 50 characters after trimming whitespace, and `params["email"]`
a plausible email address. The handler creates the user with the next free integer id and returns
`(201, user)` where user has `id`, `name` (trimmed) and `email`. It returns
`(409, {"error": "email already exists"})` when a user with the same email, ignoring case, already exists, and
`(400, {"error": "invalid user"})` for an invalid name or email. A created user must then be retrievable
with `handle_get_user`.
Add tests for the new handler to the project's test suite.


Work step by step: inspect the relevant code, make the change, and check it. When you are finished, run
`echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT` as a command on its own.

def test_get_user_invalid():
    assert handle_get_user({"id": "abc"})[0] == 400

    assert handle_get_user({"id": "99"})[0] == 404


def test_create_user_ok():
    params = {"name": "  Bob  ", "email": "bob@example.com"}
    code, user = handle_create_user(params)
    assert code == 201
    assert user["name"] == "Bob"
    assert user["email"] == "bob@example.com"
    assert "id" in user
    assert handle_get_user({"id": str(user["id"])}) == (200, user)


def test_create_user_duplicate_email():
    handle_create_user({"name": "Bob", "email": "bob@example.com"})
    code, resp = handle_create_user({"name": "Bob2", "email": "BOB@example.com"})
    assert code == 409
    assert resp["error"] == "email already exists"


def test_create_user_invalid():
    # Invalid name
    assert handle_create_user({"name": "", "email": "test@test.com"})[0] == 400
    assert handle_create_user({"name": "a" * 51, "email": "test@test.com"})[0] == 400
    # Invalid email
    assert handle_create_user({"name": "Bob", "email": "bob"})[0] == 400
    assert handle_create_user({"name": "Bob", "email": "bob@com"})[0] == 400
    # Missing fields
    assert handle_create_user({"name": "Bob"})[0] == 400
    assert handle_create_user({"email": "bob@test.com"})[0] == 400
